advancedHint: Refine your discovery. Changes take effect only when you apply them.
multiScope: Multi-select combines up to 25 candidates per language/category combination, then deduplicates and sorts them. Results are bounded, not a complete GitHub search.
recommendationEmpty: No unseen candidates match right now. Try broader filters or return later; viewed repositories will not be recycled.
latestScope: GitHub does not offer repository search sorted by creation date. This list sorts up to 300 matching, recently active candidates by their actual creation dates. Latest defaults to repositories created in the last 90 days.
title: Discover repositories
subtitle: Explore great open-source projects, one scroll at a time.
emptyHint: Try a different search or clear your filters.
trendPending: Star growth needs historical snapshots. This feed will be available after the selected period has been sampled.
trendFallback: No matching Star-growth history is available. Showing recently active popular projects, selected by total Stars—not a Star-growth ranking. The period controls recent activity; up to 100 candidates per filter combination.
searchLimit: GitHub search exposes at most 1,000 results and may return partial results. Narrow your filters to explore further.
followingLimit: This collection is bounded: up to 500 starred repositories, or the 20 most recently followed developers’ 10 recently updated public repositories each.
collectionHint: Collection search matches text; GitHub query syntax applies to Explore only.
loginDescription: Sign in to save repositories, keep your browsing history and personalize your feed.
oauthNote: Redirects to GitHub. OAuth tokens are encrypted and stored on our server. Basic sign-in does not request private repository access.
or: or use a personal access token
tokenPrivacy: Your personal token is saved only in this browser, never in our database. It is sent over HTTPS to our server only for temporary GitHub verification and API forwarding. Signing out clears it. Use this only on a trusted device.
tokenPermissions: A fine-grained token can read public repositories. To Star repositories, enable Starring read/write. A classic token needs public_repo for Star writes (this also grants broader public repository permissions).
oauthUnavailable: GitHub OAuth is not configured yet. Token sign-in is available.
starScopeNote: GitHub OAuth Apps require public_repo for Star writes. This grants broader public repository write permissions; authorization is optional.
loginPrompt: Sign in to use this feature.
footerNote: An independent project. Not affiliated with GitHub.

errors.resourceLimited: The server reached its compute limit. Please try again later.
errors.demoOnly: This is a demo. Open the full application to sign in.
errors.serverError: The server could not process this request. Please try again later.
errors.networkError: Couldn’t reach GitHub. Check your connection and try again.
errors.rateLimited: GitHub’s request limit was reached. Please wait before trying again.
errors.githubError: GitHub could not complete the request. Your token may need additional permissions.
errors.invalidSearch: GitHub could not understand this search. Check your query syntax.
errors.invalidRequest: The request is invalid. Please check your input.
errors.invalidCursor: This page expired. Refresh the feed.
errors.loginRequired: Sign in to use this feature.
errors.notFound: This repository no longer exists or is not public.
errors.reauthorize: Your GitHub authorization expired or does not match this account. Please sign in again.
errors.authUnavailable: GitHub OAuth is not configured yet. You can sign in with a personal token.
errors.authFailed: GitHub sign-in failed. Please try again.
errors.starPermission: Additional GitHub authorization is required to Star repositories.
errors.localTokenRequired: Your token is missing from this browser. Please sign in with your token again.
errors.invalidToken: Enter a valid GitHub personal access token.
errors.clipboardError: Could not copy the link. Check your browser’s clipboard permissions.
